<div class="equivalence-law" id="law-table-demorgan"><div class="law-heading"><strong>דה מורגן</strong><div class="law-formulas"><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg (A \land  B)\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \lor  \neg B\)</span></span><br><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg (A \lor  B)\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \land  \neg B\)</span></span><br><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg (\neg A \land  \neg B)\)</span></span><br><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \land  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg (\neg A \lor  \neg B)\)</span></span></div></div>
<details class="law-proof"><summary><span class="law-proof-show">הצדקת הכלל</span><span class="law-proof-hide">הסתר הצדקה</span></summary>
<p>אפשר להשתמש בחוק בשני הכיוונים, גם כדי להוציא שלילה מחוץ לסוגריים. <strong>מותר להסיר באותו צעד שלילה כפולה שנוצרת בהפעלת החוק</strong>: למשל, <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg (A \land  \neg B)\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \lor  B\)</span>. אין חובה לכתוב תחילה <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \lor  \neg \neg B\)</span>.</p><div class="law-table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="טבלת אמת: דה מורגן"><table class="law-truth-table" dir="rtl" data-rule="demorgan" data-variant="0"><caption dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg (A \land  B)\)</span> <span aria-label="שקול לוגית">≡</span> <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \lor  \neg B\)</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col" data-formula="A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A &amp; B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \land  B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!(A &amp; B)" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף שמאל</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg (A \land  B)\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!A | !B" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף ימין</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \lor  \neg B\)</span></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr>
<tr><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="law-verdict">שתי עמודות התוצאה המודגשות זהות בכל שורה. לכן שני האגפים שקולים לוגית.</p>
<div class="law-table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="טבלת אמת: דה מורגן"><table class="law-truth-table" dir="rtl" data-rule="demorgan" data-variant="1"><caption dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg (A \lor  B)\)</span> <span aria-label="שקול לוגית">≡</span> <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \land  \neg B\)</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col" data-formula="A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A | B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!(A | B)" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף שמאל</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg (A \lor  B)\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!A &amp; !B" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף ימין</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \land  \neg B\)</span></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr>
<tr><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="law-verdict">שתי עמודות התוצאה המודגשות זהות בכל שורה. לכן שני האגפים שקולים לוגית.</p>
<div class="law-derivation" data-rule="demorgan" data-variant="2"><p>מציבים <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A\)</span> ו־<span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg B\)</span> בחוק דה מורגן הראשון, ומסירים שלילות כפולות:</p><div class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg (\neg A \land  \neg B)\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg \neg A \lor  \neg \neg B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  B\)</span></div></div>
<div class="law-derivation" data-rule="demorgan" data-variant="3"><p>באותה דרך, מציבים שלילות בחוק דה מורגן השני:</p><div class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg (\neg A \lor  \neg B)\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg \neg A \land  \neg \neg B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \land  B\)</span></div></div></details></div>
<span id="rule-or-implication"></span><div class="equivalence-law" id="law-table-implication"><div class="law-heading"><strong>גרירה כ״או״</strong><div class="law-formulas"><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \to  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \lor  B\)</span></span><br><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \to  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B \lor  \neg A\)</span></span><br><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \to  B\)</span></span><br><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg B \to  A\)</span></span></div></div>
<details class="law-proof"><summary><span class="law-proof-show">הצדקת הכלל</span><span class="law-proof-hide">הסתר הצדקה</span></summary>
<p><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  B\)</span> אומר שלפחות אחד החלקים אמת: אם <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span> שקר, <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B\)</span> חייב להיות אמת. לכן הוא שקול ל־<span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \to  B\)</span>. חילוף החלקים ב״או״ נותן גם את <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg B \to  A\)</span>. <strong>הגרירה עצמה אינה חילופית</strong>: כאן גם השלילה עוברת לחלק האחר.</p><div class="law-table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="טבלת אמת: גרירה כ״או״"><table class="law-truth-table" dir="rtl" data-rule="implication" data-variant="0"><caption dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \to  B\)</span> <span aria-label="שקול לוגית">≡</span> <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \lor  B\)</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col" data-formula="A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A -&gt; B" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף שמאל</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \to  B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!A | B" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף ימין</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \lor  B\)</span></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr>
<tr><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="law-verdict">שתי עמודות התוצאה המודגשות זהות בכל שורה. לכן שני האגפים שקולים לוגית.</p>
<div class="law-derivation" data-rule="implication" data-variant="1"><p>לפי חוק החילוף, אפשר להחליף את סדר החלקים ב״או״:</p><div class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \to  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \lor  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B \lor  \neg A\)</span></div></div>
<div class="law-derivation" data-rule="implication" data-variant="2"><p>מציבים <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A\)</span> במקום <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span> בגרירה כ״או״, ומסירים שלילה כפולה:</p><div class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \to  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg \neg A \lor  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  B\)</span></div></div>
<div class="law-derivation" data-rule="implication" data-variant="3"><p>מחליפים את תפקידי <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span> ו־<span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B\)</span> בגרסה הקודמת, ומשתמשים בחוק החילוף:</p><div class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg B \to  A\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B \lor  A\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  B\)</span></div></div></details></div>
<div class="equivalence-law" id="law-table-contrapositive"><div class="law-heading"><strong>גרירה נגדית</strong><div class="law-formulas"><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \to  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg B \to  \neg A\)</span></span></div></div>
<details class="law-proof"><summary><span class="law-proof-show">הצדקת הכלל</span><span class="law-proof-hide">הסתר הצדקה</span></summary>
<div class="law-derivation" data-rule="contrapositive" data-variant="0"><p>כותבים את שתי הגרירות בעזרת ״או״. בגרירה הנגדית מסירים גם שלילה כפולה:</p><div class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \to  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \lor  B\)</span></div><div class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg B \to  \neg A\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg \neg B \lor  \neg A\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B \lor  \neg A\)</span></div><p>שתי התוצאות שקולות לפי חוק החילוף.</p></div></details></div>
<div class="equivalence-law" id="law-table-iff"><div class="law-heading"><strong>אם ורק אם</strong><div class="law-formulas"><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \leftrightarrow  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\((A \to  B) \land  (B \to  A)\)</span></span></div></div>
<details class="law-proof"><summary><span class="law-proof-show">הצדקת הכלל</span><span class="law-proof-hide">הסתר הצדקה</span></summary>
<div class="law-table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="טבלת אמת: אם ורק אם"><table class="law-truth-table" dir="rtl" data-rule="iff" data-variant="0"><caption dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \leftrightarrow  B\)</span> <span aria-label="שקול לוגית">≡</span> <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\((A \to  B) \land  (B \to  A)\)</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col" data-formula="A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A -&gt; B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \to  B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="B -&gt; A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B \to  A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A &lt;-&gt; B" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף שמאל</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \leftrightarrow  B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="(A -&gt; B) &amp; (B -&gt; A)" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף ימין</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\((A \to  B) \land  (B \to  A)\)</span></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr>
<tr><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="law-verdict">שתי עמודות התוצאה המודגשות זהות בכל שורה. לכן שני האגפים שקולים לוגית.</p></details></div>
<span id="rule-xor-rewrite"></span><div class="equivalence-law" id="law-table-xor-or"><div class="law-heading"><strong>או מפריד כ״וגם״</strong><div class="law-formulas"><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \oplus  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\((A \lor  B) \land  \neg (A \land  B)\)</span></span></div></div>
<details class="law-proof"><summary><span class="law-proof-show">הצדקת הכלל</span><span class="law-proof-hide">הסתר הצדקה</span></summary>
<p><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  B\)</span> דורש שלפחות אחד החלקים אמת; <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg (A \land  B)\)</span> פוסל את האפשרות ששניהם אמת. יחד הם דורשים בדיוק אחד.</p><div class="law-table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="טבלת אמת: או מפריד כ״וגם״"><table class="law-truth-table" dir="rtl" data-rule="xor" data-variant="0"><caption dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \oplus  B\)</span> <span aria-label="שקול לוגית">≡</span> <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\((A \lor  B) \land  \neg (A \land  B)\)</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col" data-formula="A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A | B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A &amp; B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \land  B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!(A &amp; B)"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg (A \land  B)\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A ^ B" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף שמאל</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \oplus  B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="(A | B) &amp; !(A &amp; B)" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף ימין</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\((A \lor  B) \land  \neg (A \land  B)\)</span></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr>
<tr><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="law-verdict">שתי עמודות התוצאה המודגשות זהות בכל שורה. לכן שני האגפים שקולים לוגית.</p></details></div>
<div class="equivalence-law" id="law-table-xor-cases"><div class="law-heading"><strong>או מפריד כ״או״</strong><div class="law-formulas"><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \oplus  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\((A \land  \neg B) \lor  (\neg A \land  B)\)</span></span></div></div>
<details class="law-proof"><summary><span class="law-proof-show">הצדקת הכלל</span><span class="law-proof-hide">הסתר הצדקה</span></summary>
<p>שתי האפשרויות הן: <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span> אמת ו־<span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B\)</span> שקר, או להפך. אלה בדיוק המצבים שבהם XOR הוא אמת.</p><div class="law-table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="טבלת אמת: או מפריד כ״או״"><table class="law-truth-table" dir="rtl" data-rule="xor" data-variant="1"><caption dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \oplus  B\)</span> <span aria-label="שקול לוגית">≡</span> <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\((A \land  \neg B) \lor  (\neg A \land  B)\)</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col" data-formula="A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A &amp; !B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \land  \neg B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!A &amp; B"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A \land  B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A ^ B" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף שמאל</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \oplus  B\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="(A &amp; !B) | (!A &amp; B)" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף ימין</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\((A \land  \neg B) \lor  (\neg A \land  B)\)</span></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr>
<tr><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>F</td><td>T</td><td>T</td><td>F</td><td>F</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="law-verdict">שתי עמודות התוצאה המודגשות זהות בכל שורה. לכן שני האגפים שקולים לוגית.</p></details></div>
<div class="equivalence-law" id="law-table-xor-iff"><div class="law-heading"><strong>או מפריד כ״אם ורק אם״</strong><div class="law-formulas"><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \oplus  B\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \leftrightarrow  \neg B\)</span></span></div></div>
<details class="law-proof"><summary><span class="law-proof-show">הצדקת הכלל</span><span class="law-proof-hide">הסתר הצדקה</span></summary>
<div class="law-derivation" data-rule="xor" data-variant="2"><p>לפי הגדרת ״אם ורק אם״, <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \leftrightarrow  \neg B\)</span> הוא אמת בדיוק כאשר <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span> ו־<span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg B\)</span> מקבלים אותו ערך אמת. זה קורה בדיוק כאשר <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span> ו־<span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(B\)</span> מקבלים ערכים שונים — כלומר, בדיוק אחד מהם אמת. זו הגדרת XOR.</p></div></details></div>
<div class="equivalence-law" id="law-table-tautology"><div class="law-heading"><strong>טאוטולוגיה</strong><div class="law-formulas"><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  \neg A\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(T\)</span></span></div></div>
<details class="law-proof"><summary><span class="law-proof-show">הצדקת הכלל</span><span class="law-proof-hide">הסתר הצדקה</span></summary>
<div class="law-table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="טבלת אמת: טאוטולוגיה"><table class="law-truth-table" dir="rtl" data-rule="tautology" data-variant="0"><caption dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  \neg A\)</span> <span aria-label="שקול לוגית">≡</span> <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(T\)</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col" data-formula="A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A | !A" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף שמאל</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  \neg A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="T" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף ימין</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(T\)</span></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>T</td><td>F</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="law-verdict">שתי עמודות התוצאה המודגשות זהות בכל שורה. לכן שני האגפים שקולים לוגית.</p></details></div>
<div class="equivalence-law" id="law-table-contradiction"><div class="law-heading"><strong>סתירה</strong><div class="law-formulas"><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \land  \neg A\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(F\)</span></span></div></div>
<details class="law-proof"><summary><span class="law-proof-show">הצדקת הכלל</span><span class="law-proof-hide">הסתר הצדקה</span></summary>
<div class="law-table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="טבלת אמת: סתירה"><table class="law-truth-table" dir="rtl" data-rule="contradiction" data-variant="0"><caption dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \land  \neg A\)</span> <span aria-label="שקול לוגית">≡</span> <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(F\)</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col" data-formula="A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="!A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(\neg A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A &amp; !A" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף שמאל</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \land  \neg A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="F" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף ימין</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(F\)</span></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>T</td><td>F</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td>T</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="law-verdict">שתי עמודות התוצאה המודגשות זהות בכל שורה. לכן שני האגפים שקולים לוגית.</p></details></div>
<div class="equivalence-law" id="law-table-identity"><div class="law-heading"><strong>איבר ניטרלי</strong><div class="law-formulas"><span class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(F \lor  A\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></span></div></div>
<details class="law-proof"><summary><span class="law-proof-show">הצדקת הכלל</span><span class="law-proof-hide">הסתר הצדקה</span></summary>
<div class="law-table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="טבלת אמת: איבר ניטרלי"><table class="law-truth-table" dir="rtl" data-rule="identity" data-variant="0"><caption dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(F \lor  A\)</span> <span aria-label="שקול לוגית">≡</span> <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col" data-formula="A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="F | A" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף שמאל</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(F \lor  A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף ימין</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>T</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="law-verdict">שתי עמודות התוצאה המודגשות זהות בכל שורה. לכן שני האגפים שקולים לוגית.</p>
<div class="law-derivation" data-rule="identity" data-variant="1"><p>הגרסה שבה <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(F\)</span> מימין נובעת מחוק החילוף:</p><div class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \lor  F\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(F \lor  A\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></div></div>
<div class="law-table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="טבלת אמת: איבר ניטרלי"><table class="law-truth-table" dir="rtl" data-rule="identity" data-variant="2"><caption dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(T \land  A\)</span> <span aria-label="שקול לוגית">≡</span> <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col" data-formula="A"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="T &amp; A" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף שמאל</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(T \land  A\)</span></th><th scope="col" data-formula="A" class="law-result"><span class="law-side">אגף ימין</span><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>T</td><td class="law-result">T</td><td class="law-result">T</td></tr>
<tr><td>F</td><td class="law-result">F</td><td class="law-result">F</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="law-verdict">שתי עמודות התוצאה המודגשות זהות בכל שורה. לכן שני האגפים שקולים לוגית.</p>
<div class="law-derivation" data-rule="identity" data-variant="3"><p>כך גם כשה־<span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(T\)</span> מימין:</p><div class="law-summary-formula" dir="ltr"><span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A \land  T\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(T \land  A\)</span> ≡ <span class="law-formula" dir="ltr">\(A\)</span></div></div></details></div>
